components.description: Reported casing string. ID and joint tally are not supplied; surface end is depicted at reference zero, not a measured stick-up.

components.description: Intermediate drilled hole before running casing.

components.name: Production hole / 8 3/4 in
components.description: Reported drilling TD is 10987 ft; plotted path is limited to the workbook's last survey at 10955 ft.

components.name: Surface cement interval
components.description: Cemented to surface; floats failed. Nominal annular bounds use reported hole and casing diameters, not a cement bond measurement.

components.name: Production cement interval
components.description: 433 bbl pumped, 15 bbl returned; cemented from 10787 ft to surface. Outer annular bounds are unreported in the upper cased section, so no cement envelope is inferred.

components.name: Thread-on wellhead
components.description: Reported installed on 7-inch casing. Manufacturer geometry and dimensions are unavailable; shown as a location marker only.

components.name: Master valve
components.description: Reported installed when securing the well. No pressure rating or dimensions are inferred.
